{"turns": [
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "hi my phone is barely working and im so annoyed 😡", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Daniel. How can I help you today?", "tags": ["greeting"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "my screen is flickering and i cant even use the apps. its so frustrating", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I am sorry to hear that you're having such a frustrating experience with your device, I can definitely help you look into this.", "tags": ["empathy"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "i just want it fixed now. im Fatima Iyer and my number is 97299 03137", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thanks Fatima. Let me check the system. It looks like you have the latest model, right?", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "yeah its the pro model. i tried restarting it but it didnt work", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Got it. Since the restart didn't work, it sounds like a hardware issue with the display.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "so what do we do? i cant keep using it like this", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I can arrange for a replacement device to be sent to your home address so you can swap it out.", "tags": ["action:device_fix"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "oh wow really? that would be great! thank you so much", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "You're very welcome! I've processed that request now.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "thanks daniel you've been a huge help 😊", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I'll get that replacement device shipped out immediately. Have a great day!", "tags": ["closure"]}
]}
